title: TFCGearRepair
description: Repair your armors without losing their nbt tags/data...
body:
# Gear Repairs for TerraFirmaCraft This addon is mainly meant for adding armor and tool repairs for TFC, without losing their nbt or special data. Currently only metal armor welding is supported.
(Leather etc is underway) Suggestions are welcome!
(throw me an issue on Github please)
